# India Holistic Retreats

> > Curated wellness retreats across India specializing in Ayurveda, yoga, and Panchakarma healing experiences in Kerala, Rishikesh, Goa, and beyond.

India Holistic Retreats connects travelers with authentic wellness experiences at premier Ayurvedic healing centers, yoga ashrams, and eco-resorts throughout India. The platform features traditional Panchakarma detox programs, yoga teacher training, meditation retreats, and holistic healing journeys in scenic locations from the Kerala backwaters to the Himalayan foothills.

## Key Topics

- Ayurveda
- Panchakarma detox
- Yoga and meditation
- Kerala backwaters
- Rishikesh retreats
- Goa wellness
- Holistic healing
- Eco-friendly resorts
- Spiritual healing
- Wellness tourism
- CGH Earth properties
- Himalayan retreats
- South India wellness
- Traditional healing systems
- Naturopathy

## Featured Wellness Retreats & Resorts

- [Soukya Bangalore Healing Retreat | Ayurveda & Yoga](https://www.indiaholisticretreats.com/retreat/soukya-bangalore-healing-retreat): Soukya healing retreat in Bangalore with Ayurveda, yoga & naturopathy
- [Spice Village Thekkady – Eco-Wellness Resort by CGH Earth](https://www.indiaholisticretreats.com/retreat/spice-village-thekkady-cgh-earth-kerala): CGH Earth eco-wellness resort in Thekkady with Ayurveda & spice gardens
- [Anantya by the Lake | Wellness Retreat Kanyakumari](https://www.indiaholisticretreats.com/retreat/anantya-by-the-lake): Ayurveda & yoga wellness retreat by Chittar Lake in Kanyakumari
- [Madhuban Resort & Spa – Ayurveda & Wellness Gujarat](https://www.indiaholisticretreats.com/retreat/madhuban-resort-and-spa-gujarat): Luxury Ayurveda & Panchakarma wellness resort in Gujarat
- [Passiflora Wellness Resort Pawna – Ayurveda & Yoga Retreat](https://www.indiaholisticretreats.com/retreat/passiflora-wellness-resorts-pune-maharashtra): Eco-luxury Ayurveda & yoga resort near Pawna Lake, Maharashtra
- [Yog Niketan Rishikesh – Ayurveda & Yoga Retreat](https://www.indiaholisticretreats.com/retreat/yog-niketan-rishikesh): Eco-friendly Ayurveda & yoga retreat by Ganges in Rishikesh
- [Nalanda Retreat Goa | Yoga & Wellness by the Sea](https://www.indiaholisticretreats.com/retreat/nalanda-retreat-goa): Beachside yoga & Ayurveda retreat in Mandrem, North Goa
- [Backwater Ripples Kumarakom – Ayurveda & Wellness Resort](https://www.indiaholisticretreats.com/retreat/backwater-ripples-kumarakom): Lakeside Ayurveda resort with Vedasparsh Spa on Vembanad Lake, Kumarakom
- [Rajah Island – Ayurvedic Wellness Retreat in Kerala](https://www.indiaholisticretreats.com/retreat/rajah-island-chettuva-backwaters-near-guruvayur-kerala): Island Ayurvedic retreat with Panchakarma in Chettuva backwaters, Kerala
